mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS s_id, s.date AS s_date, s.start_time AS s_start_time, s.place_id AS s_place_id, s.content AS s.content, s.place_url AS s.placeUrl, s.idx AS s.idx, p.id AS p_id, p.start_day AS p_start_day, p.end_day AS p_end_day, p.name AS p_name, p.location AS p_location FROM schedules s JOIN planners p ON s.planner_id = p.id WHERE s.id = #{s.id}

SELECT s.id AS s_id, s.planner_id AS s_planner_id, s.date AS s_date, s.start_time AS s_start_time, s.content AS s_content, s.idx AS s_idx, p.id AS p_id, p.kakao_id AS p_kakao_id, p.place_name AS p_place_name, p.address_name AS p_address_name, p.road_address_name AS p_road_address_name, p.latitude AS p_latitude, p.longitude AS p_longitude, p.phone AS p_phone, p.save_count AS p_save_count, p.category_id AS p_category_id, c.category_name AS p_category_name FROM schedules s JOIN places p ON p.id = s.place_id LEFT JOIN places_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE s.planner_id = #{plannerId} ORDER BY s.idx
